title: Woman Violates Boyfriend After He Pulls Out Lollipop Ring To Propose At Red Sox & Blue Jays Game [Watch]
htmlContent:
A man was slapped after asking his girlfriend to marry him with a lollipop ring at a baseball game.

Over the weekend, some lucky girl thought she was about to get engaged to her boyfriend during the Toronto Blue Jays and Boston Red Sox Major League Baseball with thousands of fans.

Assuming the proposal would navigate smoothly, the official camera team for the game also began filming the time to share on large screens.

The man then kneels on the stairs, removes a black box from his left jean pocket, and, to the woman's and the crowd's surprise, open the box to reveal a Ring Pop.

Seeing the red ring lollipop, the young woman immediately slaps her partner while Blue Jays fans shouting.

“What the f*** is wrong with you,” she says while throwing her drink at the man.
